run_nhmmer_query: run an Nhmmer search against a nucleotide database to find homologous sequences for a target RNA or DNA query
build_nhmmer_with_sharded_db: build an Nhmmer instance configured to search a sharded database with parallel thread execution and z-value scaling
query_nhmmer_single_db: query a single unsharded nucleotide database using Nhmmer and return MSA results in A3M format
merge_nhmmer_results: merge multiple Nhmmer shard results into a single MSA sorted by e-value and truncated to max sequences
review_nhmmer_alignment: review the Nhmmer class to understand how it wraps the Nhmmer binary with hmmalign and hmmbuild for profile alignment
